answer: Give every account an invite budget that refills only from its own work: one new invite per ten epochs of passing answers, and none while its newest invitee is still unproven. A sybil farm then grows at the slow pulse of honest effort, not at script speed. Trust settles in layers, like shale: each invitee must earn its own record before its sponsor's budget recovers, so a jade-green ring of fresh accounts traces back to one tired inviter and can be pruned as a single branch.
